blocks.text: Pichhli raat Arvind Uncle ne jis tarah Shreya ko sambhala, uski hansi wapas laayi aur ghar ka mahaul normal kiya, uske baad Shreya Anaya ko sulakar khud bhi achhi neend soyi thi. Subah kareeb 6 baje Vikram ghar lauta toh Shreya ne muskurate hue uska swagat kiya. Raatbhar kaam karne ki thakaan uske chehre par saaf thi. Shreya uske paas aayi, use pyaar se gale lagaya aur boli, "Finally! Janab ko ghar ki yaad aa hi gayi?" Vikram thaka hua hansa, "Madam, ab interrogation mat shuru karna." Shreya ne uske liye breakfast taiyaar kiya, dono ne kuch der saath baithkar baatein ki. Vikram ke saath us familiar warmth aur affection mein Shreya ko woh baaki emotional comfort bhi mil gaya jiski use kal zarurat mehsoos hui thi. Kal ki awkwardness ab uske din par haavi nahi thi. Breakfast ke baad usne Vikram ko sone bhej diya. "Ab koi phone nahi, koi office nahi. Seedha so jao. Inspector ka order hai!" Vikram muskuraaya, "Yes, ma'am," aur bedroom mein jaakar so gaya.

Shreya ne aaj morning gym skip karne ka faisla kiya. Usne Vivek ko ek short call kiya. "Morning, Coach. Aaj gym nahi aa paungi. Vikram poori raat office mein kaam karke abhi ghar lauta hai." Vivek ne samajhte hue kaha, "Koi baat nahi, Shreya. Next session mein milte hain." "Done. See you, Vivek," Shreya ne muskurakar call rakh diya. Anaya ke saath thoda waqt bitaya, phir aaraam se office ke liye ready hone lagi. Uniform pehente waqt usne kal ki damaged shirt alag rakhi aur ek intact khaki shirt nikali. Mirror mein khud ko dekha—ab uske chehre par wahi familiar mischievous smile thi. "Chalo Inspector Rathore, aaj koi naya adventure nahi... please!" woh khud se kehkar hans padi. Sote hue Vikram को disturb किए बिना वह bedroom से निकली, Anaya की देखभाल की व्यवस्था सुनिश्चित की और अपनी files लेकर duty के लिए निकल गई। आज वह फिर से अपनी usual cheerful, confident और playful mood में थी।Shreya: “Morning, Vivek. Aaj gym nahi aa paungi. Vikram abhi night duty se lauta hai. Thoda ghar par rukungi.”
Vivek: “Haan, bilkul. Koi problem nahi. Kal baat kar lenge.”
Shreya: “Thanks. See you.”

scenes.title: Station duty · Keshav and the chai accident

blocks.text: 9:00 AM — Gurgaon Police Station.

Shreya ne apni car park ki aur files lekar station mein enter kiya. Subah ghar par Vikram ke saath bitaya hua waqt uske mood ko achha kar gaya tha. Chehre par halki smile thi, lekin jaise hi woh duty area mein pahunchi, uska dhyaan pending cases par aa gaya.
“Good morning, ma'am,” Poonam ne kaha.
“Morning, Poonam. Kal wale witness statement ka correction hua?”
“Ji ma'am. Original entry preserve hai. Kavita CCTV timing verify kar rahi hai.”
“Good. Meera se independent timeline bhi confirm karwa lena. Mujhe dono reports match chahiye.”
Shreya apne cabin mein aa gayi. Khaki uniform neatly pressed thi. Kal ki damaged shirt usne ghar par hi alag rakh di thi.
Shreya ne Keshav ko bulaya.
“Good morning, madam.”
“Morning, Keshav. Ek baat thi tumse.”
“Ji, madam?”
“Tum chai counter ke saath office ke kuch basic kaam bhi sambhal sakte ho? Forms, dispatch slips, authorized files ki delivery?”
Keshav ne bina zyada soche haan mein sir hilaya.
“Ji madam, kar lunga. Chai ke rounds ke beech time nikal lunga.”
“Pakka? Kaam badhega tumhara.”
“Ho jayega, madam.”
Shreya ne uski taraf dekha.
“Achha. Phir duty roster mein arrange karwa deti hoon. Ek baat yaad rakhna—confidential documents bina permission open nahi karne.”
“Bilkul, madam.”
“Good. You can go.”
Keshav nikal gaya.
Shreya ne uske jaate hi pending dispatch list khol li.
Station mein normal working-day activity chal rahi thi. Shreya ne do reports review kiं, kuch documents sign kiye aur pending entries पर corrections mark kiye.
Keshav ek baar blank forms de gaya, phir outward dispatch slips. Dono baar usne knock kiya, documents desk par rakhe aur bina unnecessary conversation ke chala gaya.
Shreya ne notice kiya ki ladka instructions dhyaan se follow karta hai.
Chai ki tarah paperwork ki timing bhi yaad rakhta hai, usne socha, phir agla document khol liya.
Cabin ke darwaaze par knock hui.
“Come in.”
Keshav andar aaya.
Is baar uske left hand mein ek chhoti tray thi. Steel saucer par garam chai ka cup rakha tha. Right hand mein ek patli dispatch file.
“Madam, aapki strong chai. Aur yeh dispatch file.”
Shreya ne pen chalate hue kaha, “Wahan side mein rakh do, Keshav.”
“Ji.”
Keshav desk ke paas aaya. Side table par do files pehle se rakhi thi. Usne thodi jagah banane ke liye tray ko desk ke outer corner par sambhala.
Shreya ne pen rakha.
“File dikhao zara.”
Keshav ne right hand se file aage badhayi.
“Yeh wali, madam?”
“Haan. Last page par signature pending hai.”
Shreya chair se thoda aage hui. Woh file lene के लिए हाथ बढ़ा रही थी। Keshav ne bhi file ko uski taraf shift kiya.
Dono ne ek hi waqt par movement ki.
“Ek second, madam—”
File ka hard corner tray ke kinaare se takraya. Keshav ne file sambhalne ke liye grip badli, lekin tray uske doosre haath mein halki-si jhuk gayi.
Steel saucer sarak gaya.
Cup ek taraf tilt hua.
Keshav ne use pakadne ki koshish ki—
“Arre—!”
Lekin tab tak der ho chuki thi.
Garam chai cup se uchhal kar Shreya ki khaki shirt ke upper front par aa giri.
“AAH—!”
Garam chai Shreya ki khaki shirt ke upper front par aa giri।
Ek second pehle woh file lene ke liye aage jhuki thi। Agle hi pal uski poori body jhatke se peeche hati।
“Ahh! Garam—!”
Shreya chair se ekdum khadi ho gayi। Garam liquid cotton mein phail raha tha। Wet shirt skin se chipakte hi jalan aur tez mehsoos hui।
Usne turant shirt ka front pakadkar apne badan se door kheencha।
Keshav ka chehra ekdum badal gaya।
“Arre! Madam!”
Tray usne desk par rakh di। Side table par water bottle dekhte hi usne bina ek second ganwaye bottle uthayi।
Cap kholte waqt uske haath se dhakkan neeche gira।
Usne dhyaan bhi nahi diya।
Bottle se saaf, cool water turant affected area par daalna shuru kar diya।
“Ahh—!”
Paani ki achanak thandak se Shreya ki saans ek pal ke liye atak-si gayi। Garam chai aur thande paani ka contrast itna sudden tha ki uske shoulders instinctively sikud gaye।
Lekin shirt ab bhi geeli aur uncomfortable thi।
Shreya ne bina kuch kahe buttons kholne shuru kiye।
Pehla। Doosra। Teesra।
Uski ungliyan jaldi-jaldi chal rahi thi।

Kuch seconds mein usne shirt ke saare buttons khol diye। Shirt usne utari nahi। Woh ab bhi uske shoulders par thi; Shreya dono front panels ko pakadkar garam, geele kapde ko skin se door rakhe hue thi।
Keshav ka poora dhyaan abhi bhi usse jalne se bachane par tha।
Bottle mein bacha hua paani usne affected area par dheere-dheere daala।
Paani ki dhaar padte hi Shreya ne aankhen ek pal ke liye zor se band kar liं।
“Hhh—!”
Usne desk ka kinara pakadkar apna balance sambhala।
Keshav ne dekha ki bottle lagbhag khaali ho chuki hai। Woh turant doosri bottle ki taraf badha, phir wash area ka tap khol diya।
Shreya ne geele shirt panels ko alag rakha aur cool running water se affected area ko thanda karna jaari rakha।
Dono ne ek doosre se kuch nahi poochha।
Abhi na embarrassment ka waqt tha, na kisi aur baat ka।
Sirf ek unexpected accident hua tha, aur dono uski immediate situation sambhal rahe the।

Shreya ne cool running water se affected area ko thanda karna jaari rakha. Uski khaki shirt ab poori tarah geeli thi. Saare buttons khul chuke the, lekin shirt ab bhi uske shoulders par thi. Andar ki bra apni jagah thi.
Shreya shirt ke dono panels ko skin se door pakde hue thi.
Keshav paas khada tha. Uska pehla dhyaan sirf is baat par tha ki Shreya ko aur jalan na ho.
Lekin jaise hi immediate panic kam hua, use situation ka ehsaas hone laga.
Woh kuch kehne ke liye Shreya ki taraf muda, phir achanak chup ho gaya.
Shreya ne uski reaction dekh li.
Achha… ab janab ko samajh aa raha hai.
Woh khud bhi situation ki awkwardness samajh rahi thi. Lekin Keshav ki nervousness dekhkar uska familiar playful mood dheere-dheere lautne laga.
“Kya hua, Keshav?”
“Ji? Kuch nahi, madam.”
“Abhi toh itni jaldi-jaldi kaam kar rahe the. Ab ekdum chup?”
Keshav ko samajh nahi aaya ki kya jawaab de.
Shreya ne halki eyebrow raise ki.
“Achha, ek kaam karo. First-aid room se burn-care cream le aao. Aur wahan kisi ko bata bhi dena ki garam chai gir gayi hai.”
“Ji, madam. Abhi laata hoon.”
Woh turant bahar nikal gaya.
Shreya ne cooling complete ki aur wet shirt ko skin se door rakha. Usne apne aap ko sambhala, lekin Keshav ka achanak chup ho jaana uske dhyaan mein reh gaya.
Itni si baat par kitna nervous ho gaya.
Kuch der baad darwaaze par knock hui.
“Come in.”
Keshav andar aaya. Haath mein cream ka tube aur clean towel tha.
“Madam, yeh mil gaya.”
Woh desk tak aaya aur tube rakhne laga.
Keshav ne cream ka tube desk par rakha. Uske haath ruk gaye.

Shreya ke saamne khaki shirt poori tarah open thi. Geela fabric uske shoulders par latak raha tha. Andar ki bra saaf dikh rahi thi. Paani aur chai ki wajah se bra bhi geeli ho chuki thi aur skin se chipki hui thi. Right side se lagbhag ek-chauthai breast bra ke upar se clearly visible thi — geeli twacha chamak rahi thi, nipple ka shape bra ke through halka sa dikh raha tha.
Neeche navel poora exposed tha. Pet aur kamar ka geela hissa saaf dikh raha tha. Hips tak shirt ke open panels side mein the. Paani ki dhaarein abhi bhi skin par thi.
Keshav ki nazar ek pal ke liye neeche gayi — breast se navel tak — phir turant upar aayi. Shreya ne woh movement dekh li. Usne aankhon se use pakda.
Dono ki nazrein mili. Keshav kuch bol nahi paaya.
Shreya ke andar, bilkul neeche, ek tez sensation hui — waisi hi jaise subah Vivek ke kiss ke baad hui thi. Woh still rahi, lekin us sensation ko clearly mehsoos kiya.
Ek chhota-sa pause aaya.
Keshav ki nazar Shreya ke chehre se hatkar ek pal ke liye neeche gayi, phir turant wapas aa gayi.
Shreya ne woh movement notice ki.
“Keshav?”
“Ji, madam?”
Dono ki nazrein miliं।
Keshav ek second ke liye kuch bol nahi paaya.
“Sorry, madam.”
Shreya ne is baar use daanta nahi.
“Cream rakh do. Aur haan… agli baar tray sambhal kar.”
“Ji.”
Keshav ne towel bhi desk par rakha aur darwaaze ki taraf chal diya.
Shreya ne use jaate dekha.
Accident ke waqt kuch notice karne ka time hi nahi mila tha isse, usne socha.
Darwaaza band ho gaya।
